final_message:
`tsc` isn't installed and the registry is blocked, so `npm test` (which runs the TS directly via Node) is the available verification.

Implemented `parseQuery` in src/query.ts:8 per the README rules — skips the leading `?` and empty pairs, splits on `&`, splits each pair at the first `=`, decodes `+` as space then percent-escapes (falling back to the raw text if decoding fails), and collapses repeated keys into ordered arrays. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.
